## USB Drive Inventory Collector 4.2.9

This consolidated changelog covers the releases and improvements from **4.0.0 through 4.2.9**.

### Windows Application

- Added a native Windows GUI distributed as a self-contained, signed x64 executable. It can be opened directly, requests administrator access, and offers to install smartmontools with WinGet when it is missing.
- Combined the GUI and terminal workflows in the same executable. The terminal can run inside its own tab or in a separate console with `--terminal`; the separate PowerShell collector was removed.
- Added pause and resume controls, activity and version details, per-session logging, notification sounds with a saved mute setting, and an AutoPlay prompt that restores the prior setting on normal exit.
- Made the embedded Terminal accept commands and prompt answers, share the scan pause state with the GUI, and keep its enable/disable control visible while it is running. Added clear paused-state feedback and refined the Terminal and Workbook Setup layouts.
- Added a Finish screen with the saved workbook location and controls to copy the path, open its folder, or close the app.

### Drive Detection and Entry

- Detects USB-connected physical drives while excluding Windows boot and system disks. Automatic identification uses smartmontools autodetection and transport fallbacks for common USB storage bridges.
- Added and refined NVMe, SATA, PATA, and IDE identification, including SAT 12-byte pass-through. Probe results are logged by transport to help diagnose adapters that return incomplete data or time out.
- Increased the smartmontools process timeout to 30 seconds and corrected the JSON command option that prevented automatic reads. Invalid smartmontools options are now surfaced as command errors.
- Expanded manual drive entry with a searchable, alphabetized list covering common and less common drive and media types, including SAS, IDE, PATA, floppy, SD, CompactFlash, and eMMC. Users can select **Other** and enter a custom type.
- Added input validation, uppercase model and serial values, `N/A` for blank fields, review and edit steps, duplicate-serial checks and correction, and a Copy Last Drive workflow for entering multiple drives with different serial numbers.

### Workbook and Recorded Drives

- Saves records to XLSX after each drive without Excel automation. Workbook Setup lets users choose optional identity columns and set separate workbook and log locations.
- Reworked workbook generation with the Open XML SDK. Each save is written to a temporary file, validated before replacing the existing workbook, and retried if a save fails.
- Added build checks that generate a sample workbook, read it back, validate its Open XML structure, and verify it with an independent spreadsheet reader.
- Added the Recorded Drives, Activity, and Terminal views. Recorded Drives supports sorting, display-only row numbers, and double-click editing of the correct record, including after sorting.
- Added Reset View for the grid, along with workbook path copy and folder controls. Grid and footer layout, scrolling, and editing behavior were refined across the 4.2.x updates.
- Moved Workbook Setup and Version Information into the banner, added sorting for the display-only row number, and improved the status display with pulsing blue reads, green success, red errors, dark-yellow duplicate warnings, and a minimum three-second result display.

### Distribution

- Added a versioned Windows release workflow that signs the executable, verifies the publisher, and publishes a SHA-256 checksum. Pull requests also produce unsigned preview builds for testing.
